This implies that Isoneobavachalcone may interact with the transporter through the action of Sivelestat, potentially modulating its activity. The evidence highlights a chain of interactions involving a transporter and its inhibitor, suggesting a possible mechanism by which Isoneobavachalcone could influence the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1.
